purpose: Physically validate the Computer Use P1B product mapping implementation end-to-end: stable display observation, mapped frame acquisition and product-owned capture-pixel to primary-display-logical point conversion, without executing an input action.
requiredClaims: the real product acquireMappedPrimaryVisualFrame path returns VISUAL_FRAME_MAPPED
the product mapping is RESOLVED but remains validationState IMPLEMENTED during the validating run
the mapped path derives its transform from stable display observations surrounding the real P1A capture
the mapping source is capture-pixel/top-left and destination is primary-display-logical/top-left
the transform is axis-aligned with rotation zero in the initial scope
two independently known test-owned AppKit marker centers are found in the captured PNG
mapCapturePointToPrimaryLogical maps both observed capture-pixel centers to the independently known logical centers within bounded tolerance
P1A remains available as an unmapped acquisition path
no pointer, click, drag, wheel or keyboard action is performed
frame payload and marker coordinates are not persisted or logged
fixture and Computer Control runtime are cleaned up
nonClaims: no OCR or VLM provider is validated
no visual candidate is semantically identified
no action derived from visual perception is executed
event delivery is not equated with semantic task success

promotionOnPass.nextPhase: P2 perception provider contract and first local OCR/vision provider
